### Activity 3 Complete the following dialogue by adding question tags.

Tanim: Well, Neena, you went to see Hamlet last night, didn't you?

Neena: Oh, yes. I did. But how do you know? You didn't come to my house, __________?

Tanim: No, I didn't. Tell me, you couldn't hear the dialogues very well from where you sat, __________?

Neena: No, I couldn't. But how do you really know? I'm sure you were there, __________?

Tanim: Yes, dear. I was sitting two rows behind you.

Neena: Why didn't you come and talk to me after the play?

Tanim: You were with Harun. You wouldn't have liked that, __________?
